criteria.criterion: One competing reviewed generation commits; stale peers reject.
Crash outcomes are explicitly recovered or marked reconciliation-required.
Every application separately registers its exact successor; no saved receipt authorizes apply.

decisions.decision: Use SQLite synchronous FULL transactional authoritative metadata and a checked HEAD mirror, under exclusively mediated cooperating writers.
decisions.basis: The plan explicitly rejects rename/advisory-lock CAS claims.

decisions.decision: Each public apply obtains a fresh owned qualification and consumes it once before commit; saved receipts cannot enter the commit API.
Crash probes must be actual separate process exits. Report metadata-only injected probes separately from real theorem-qualified application integrations.
decisions.basis: P08 crash coverage and no fabricated qualification.

decisions.decision: Store initialization and tests are confined to new P08 candidate fixture stores. No real or canonical head is used.

Preserve the existing independent registration semantics: each application freshly checks its proposal and separately checks the exact successor as an identity extension. Genesis must have been freshly independently registered at creation.
decisions.basis: Retained S09 behavior and P00 fresh-versus-recorded evidence boundary.

decisions.decision: Preserve optional composed mappings through separately supervised fresh concrete witnesses; require yes, known positive inheritance condition and no active conflict. Bind each mapped request/context without merging epochs.
decisions.basis: Retained S09 composed-context behavior plus explicit P04 activation/conflict distinctions.

decisions.decision: Accepted P07 owns qualification runtime evidence under p07/consumer-runs/P08*. Implementation, schemas, mapped jobs and store state remain inside P08.
decisions.basis: Calling the accepted public API retains its run-root ownership boundary; accepted sources are not edited.

decisions.decision: The full publication test may inspect its already freshly initialized generation-zero fixture after a corrected fixture attempt. It must not reset a published store or transfer live application events; every subsequent application starts new proposal and successor-registration checks.
decisions.basis: Genesis evidence is historical registration, while application readiness is process-local and newly obtained.
